I found no changelog entry showing that Cloudflare's Agent class switched to extending `DurableObject` directly. The sources I found all describe the current design as a layered chain, where `Agent` sits on top of partyserver's `Server`.

The official Cloudflare docs say the Agent class does not inherit from the Durable Object base class itself. `Agent` does not extend `DurableObject` directly. It extends `Server` from the partyserver package, which extends `DurableObject`. The same page describes the stack as layers: **DurableObject** > **Server** > **Agent**.

The docs also say what `Server` contributes. `Server` does not add any storage operations of its own — it only wraps the Durable Object lifecycle. Its role is to provide helpers for addressing Durable Objects by name, which the Agent layer uses for routing.

Some third-party write-ups repeat the same hierarchy. One describes the stack as a four-layer chain that adds AIChatAgent adds conversational message handling on top of Agent. These are secondary sources, so I'd weight them below the official docs.

The search didn't surface the agents package changelog itself. To check whether the inheritance changed in a particular release, look at the `CHANGELOG.md` in the cloudflare/agents GitHub repository, and the partyserver package's changelog. Search the changelogs for "Server" or "DurableObject" near the `Agent` class definition in `packages/agents/src/index.ts`, which the docs link to as the source of truth.

content.text:
No, not anymore. On the current `main` branch of cloudflare/agents, `Agent` extends Cloudflare's `DurableObject` directly, imported from `cloudflare:workers`. That changed in `agents` v0.22.0 (PR #2133): the PartyServer runtime pieces the SDK needs were copied into the package under `agents/lifecycle`, and `Agent` was rebased onto `DurableObject`. Agents created by older releases can still find their names through a read-only `__ps_name` fallback. Some docs and third-party write-ups, including Cloudflare's "Agent class" page and the v0.20.1 docs, still show the old `DurableObject → Server → Agent` chain. That's only accurate for versions before 0.22.0.

- [agents@0.20.1 docs: Demystifying the Agent class](https://unpkg.com/agents@0.20.1/docs/agent-class.md)
